limitations: Entropy rejection-stage ownership unit controls use a synthetic source; they do not separately inject every real kernel mapping or submission failure.
Host interop uses the cfg(test) host entropy source; native Cortex-A710 S3/Kafka exercises the real owned VirtIO RNG RPC source because that CPU lacks RNDR.
Existing cipher-local zeroizers and typed key owners do not prove full key-schedule/HKDF/IV, compiler-copy, forced-termination or physical-memory erasure.
The verifier supports directly root-signed leafs, not general intermediate chain validation.
No formal-model, remote CI/branch-protection, license/provenance, production trust or physical-platform side-channel qualification was performed.
Passing repeats do not establish causes for historical scheduler/IPC/root-close/NIC failures.
The complete cross-workspace host-driver script was not rerun; selected service/launch/signer/transport suites are recorded in each mode.
